title: Phone format
skill: List every input rule, including what is invalid

good: Rewrite to_e164(raw, default_country="US") in phone.py. 1) Remove spaces and the characters - . ( ). Any other non-digit character raises ValueError. A '+' is allowed only as the first character. 2) Then a leading '00' means '+'. 3) With '+': keep the digits as they are; there must be 8 to 15 digits, else ValueError. 4) Without '+': a default_country other than 'US' raises ValueError; 10 digits gives '+1' + digits; 11 digits that start with 1 gives '+' + digits; anything else raises ValueError. Only change phone.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: Make to_e164 handle all phone number formats properly.
